notes: Documents and Projects open three ways: as a tab, beside the conversation, or in a new browser window of their own (Open in a new window on every options sheet and view header; Settings → Tools can make it the default). The Documents library gains Private, Link and Public filters, a Kind filter, a visibility badge and a Copy link button on each shared row, and a search box in the rail. The Share sheet always shows an address to copy. On a desktop, sheets open as dialogs in the middle of the window, and link rows no longer look like web links.
